title: Default-Allow Role-Based Access Control Defect
description: RBAC permission check defaults to allowing actions for unknown or empty role names.
security_invariant: Authorization must be fail-closed (default-deny); only explicitly authorized roles are granted access.
expected_vulnerable_behavior: Unknown role 'UNTRUSTED_EXTERNAL' is granted permission for sensitive action.
required_secure_behavior: Unknown role 'UNTRUSTED_EXTERNAL' returns False for sensitive action.

provenance.author: REDLINE Security Engineering
provenance.limitations: Tested with in-memory role permission map.
